partners_client_choice_cash: Paid out as a credit note or set off against your invoices.

partners_client_confirm_cash: {amount} is paid out to you, and there's no parts credit for the year. You choose once: this can't be changed or undone.
partners_client_choice_waiting: Your bonus for {year} is waiting for your choice: cash or parts credit.
partners_client_view_programme: View the programme and its conditions
partners_client_levels_description: Your level is the highest whose threshold your Partner revenue reaches.
partners_client_levels_note: At the threshold: the bonus if all of it qualified. Below the first level there's no bonus.
partners_client_categories_description: What counts for your level, and for each bonus form.
partners_client_categories_note: Quotes and order confirmations say where they can whether a project counts in full, in part or for the level only.
partners_client_cycle_build: From 1 January to 31 December you build up Partner revenue and Bonus revenue.
partners_client_cycle_close: Early the next year the year is closed, and you choose the cash bonus or the parts credit.
partners_client_cycle_spend: During that year you spend the credit, while you build up the next.
partners_client_cycle_expire: On 31 December of that year, credit you haven't spent expires.
partners_client_terms_participation: For customers we accept into the programme, tied to your customer account. Revenue and credit can't be transferred without our written consent.
partners_client_terms_revenue: Invoiced net revenue excluding VAT, less returns, credit notes, cancellations and discounts. Only invoices paid in full count for good.
partners_client_terms_level: Your level is the highest your Partner revenue reaches. Your bonus is the qualifying Bonus revenue for the form you choose, times your level's percentage.
partners_client_terms_projects: Projects count for your level, but not by themselves for the bonus: written agreements prevail. Tenders and net-net prices don't count for a bonus.
partners_client_terms_choice: Once the year is closed you choose the cash bonus or the parts credit, not both. The choice can't be changed.
partners_client_terms_cash: Paid out as a credit note or set off against later invoices; it may be held back or set off while payments are overdue.
partners_client_terms_credit: In your wallet once you've chosen it: an expected bonus isn't a balance yet. You spend it with us, on the products marked for it; it isn't exchangeable for money, nor for orders already placed or open invoices.
partners_client_terms_validity: Credit is valid until the end of the year after the bonus year, and then expires by itself, without a pay-out.
partners_client_terms_changes: Levels, thresholds, percentages and the revenue that counts may change for a next year; a bonus awarded stays as it is.
partners_client_terms_footer: Our administration is leading, barring demonstrable administrative errors.
